2. The drill must never mutate agent-wrapper-main.ts on disk. The source is read by readFileSync, so the drill transforms the test module in memory, and the config is deleted and proven gone.
3. The full-suite-gate lease holder may be a crashed seat. Prove the holder is live before parking behind it, and route a stale lease to the governor.
4. The shared checkout can gain a peer hunk in the test file. Run `git diff HEAD -- <file>` before editing, and never sweep a foreign hunk.
